tutorial.title: Meet the team
tutorial.body: Angela runs fulfillment, Phil handles sales calls from the Sales desk, and Marty collects inbound blanks. Roles bind to actor IDs; names and assignments are editable in the exported scenario.

tutorial.title: Receiving and packing
tutorial.body: Marty carries blanks from the receiving rack to the warehouse. Angela withdraws inputs, stocks the packing bench and produces cartons. Inputs and outputs remain physical inventories.

tutorial.title: Customer orders
tutorial.body: Phil’s successful customer calls create waiting orders. Deposited cartons let Angela collect, deliver and ship them through Dispatch. Coins and shipment receipts appear only after the physical sale.

tutorial.title: Take the whole scenario with you
tutorial.body: Export the scenario to edit this team, roles, calls, stock rules, floor theme and embedded furniture/creature catalogs. Import it to switch the complete game setting. Export a story for exact continuation.
